entities.name: Establish resource lifecycle handler laws
entities.summary: Execute a bounded affine cleanup model with explicit transfer, reverse finalization, child-scope blocking, and honest scripted outcomes before promoting syntax or kernel machinery.

acceptance: Successful acquisition creates exactly one cleanup owner
Explicit release and scope exit finalize at most once
Scope exit finalizes in reverse registration order across every exit cause
Ownership transfer is explicit and conserves one owner
Parent cleanup is blocked while an owned child scope remains open
Scripted outcomes never masquerade as external resource observations

relations.summary: The tracer realizes the first executable law-model obligation selected by the algebra promotion frontier.
The pure law model constrains later resource handlers without selecting one runtime realization.
